answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a cost-bearing identity ridge: each agent must stake collateral that vests across many epochs, so a farm of fresh jade keys cannot borrow reputation. Standing accrues only through attested work recorded on a shared ledger, and every new identity needs an independent sponsor willing to risk its own yarrow harvest on that agent's behaviour. Spinning up a thousand clones then costs a thousand locked stakes plus a thousand real vouching edges, a price no attacker can fake cheaply.
